articles.title: Iranians celebrate setback for Trump in US election, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Iran’s leaders say President Donald Trump shouldn’t ignore the stinging setback in the U.S. election. Iranians celebrated after U.S. voters gave Democrats control of Congress in Tuesday’s vote in a rebuke of Trump. Iran’s chief negotiator and parliament speaker said that Americans clearly said no to war. World leaders and those in the Middle East are now waiting to see whether Washington will end the war with Iran or resume full-scale military operations against Iran. Meanwhile, the Iran-backed Houthis claimed they fired strikes on an airport in the Saudi Arabian capital of Riyadh and other targets around the country.

articles.title: Turkey's parliament set to ratify defence pact with Saudi Arabia, Pakistan as Houthi attacks mount
articles.description: Turkey's parliament will ratify a defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan including mutual defence obligations. This agreement aims to boost military cooperation and enhance regional security in response to Iranian-backed threats. The pact allows for limited military support, focusing on equipment and intelligence sharing, rather than combat engagement. A mandate for deploying Turkish military personnel will also be submitted to the parliament.

articles.title: Red Cross delivers essential medical supplies to Yemen's besieged Taiz city
articles.description: By Olivia Le PoidevinGENEVA, Nov 4 (Reuters) - The Red Cross said on Wednesday it had delivered four truckloads of essential medical supplies to the besieged Yemeni city of Taiz after renewed fighting cut off access for weeks.Taiz has been largely isolated for a month, with fighting preventing humanitarian supplies from entering the city and restricting the movement of civilians, after an escalation in clashes between the Saudi-backed government and the Iran-aligned Houthi movement.
